headline: Regional Fire and Peak Season Access Updates
reservation: Entry to the forest generally does not require a reservation, but developed campgrounds frequently reach capacity months in advance. Overnight wilderness permits are mandatory for specific areas like the Granite Chief Wilderness; verify current permit systems via the official Forest Service website as policies are subject to seasonal changes.

days.title: Granite Peaks and History

stops.name: Donner Summit
stops.detail: View the historic railroad snowsheds and ancient petroglyphs etched into the granite landscape.

stops.name: Donner Lake
stops.detail: A hub for kayaking and paddleboarding surrounded by dramatic mountain cliffs.

days.driving: Allow 1 to 2 hours; conditions vary by mountain traffic
days.note: High-altitude sun is intense; carry ample water for all outdoor stops.

days.title: Western Slope Heritage

stops.name: Yuba River
stops.detail: Known for smooth granite boulders and emerald-green swimming holes ideal for wading.

stops.name: South Yuba River State Park
stops.detail: Explore historic bridges and trails that follow the river's path through lush forest.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; winding canyon roads require caution
days.note: Lower elevations are warmer; check for fire weather watches before using riverfront pits.

days.title: High Country Vistas

stops.name: Sierra Buttes Lookout
stops.detail: A challenging hike to a historic fire lookout with 360-degree views of the Lakes Basin.

stops.name: Lakes Basin Recreation Area
stops.detail: A collection of quiet glacial lakes suitable for fishing or meditative walks.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours; remote gravel access may be slow
days.note: Seasonal maintenance or downed trees may affect trail access; check local reports.

intel.title: Trailhead Congestion
intel.text: Parking lots at Sierra Buttes and Donner Summit fill early during summer weekends. Plan to arrive before peak morning hours to secure space at popular trailheads.

intel.title: Connectivity Limits
intel.text: Cellular reception is extremely limited within the North Fork American River canyons. Download offline maps for navigation before leaving the gateway cities.

intel.title: Mountain Supply
intel.text: Fuel is readily available in Truckee and Grass Valley but scarce within the forest interior. Ensure your tank is sufficient for remote stretches along Highway 49.

intel.title: Seasonal Windows
intel.text: High-country trails are typically accessible from June through September after snowmelt. Early autumn offers stable weather, though daylight hours decrease rapidly.

intel.title: Road Conditions
intel.text: Check Caltrans and Forest Service updates for seasonal road closures in the high Sierra. Many forest roads are unpaved and unsuitable for low-clearance vehicles.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Truckee Tahoe Airport (TKF), pick up a rental vehicle, and stock up on supplies in Truckee before heading to your forest lodging.
plan.vehicle: An SUV is recommended for navigating unpaved forest service roads; check rental agreements for off-pavement restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Donner Summit offers expansive western views for sunset, depending on seasonal cloud cover.
